verdict.rationale: Otter's own homepage claims "live transcription in multiple languages," so multilingual transcription is a documented first-party capability. That is a single thin mention with no language list, no depth, and nothing on summaries or switching. missing for 10: list or count of supported languages, evidence that summaries work in non-English languages, handling of language switching within a meeting, independent or hands-on corroboration of non-English accuracy.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run meetings in languages other than English — transcription and summaries support many languages and handle language switching

citations.quote: Live transcription in multiple languages, and speaker recognition.
